root_cause_summary: Backend server not restarted after FR-050-FR-069 code merged. Schema migrations never applied. Traceability chain broken at 4 of 9 links.

p1_findings.title: Live DB Missing All FR-052 Schema Migrations
p1_findings.recommendation: Restart backend server to apply idempotent migrations. Add post-merge restart to pipeline runbook.

p1_findings.title: Feedback API Returns 404 in Live Environment
p1_findings.recommendation: Restart server (same root cause as QUAL-P001). Routes defined but not loaded at startup.

p1_findings.title: No Bugs Have FR/Internal Ticket References
p1_findings.recommendation: Restart server. Populate related_work_item_id on bug creation. Backfill existing bugs.

p1_findings.title: Tickets Missing Issue Information and Considered Fixes
p1_findings.recommendation: Restart server. Ensure ticket creation populates work_item_ref, issue_description, considered_fixes per FR-055.

p1_findings.title: Dev Cycles Do Not Show Team Attribution
p1_findings.recommendation: Restart server. Also hydrate team_name in listCycles(), not just getCycleById().

p1_findings.title: Zero Feedback Records — Feedback Loop Not Exercised
p1_findings.recommendation: Restart server. Ensure completeStage() creates feedback records per FR-060.

p1_findings.title: Features Missing Traceability Reports
p1_findings.recommendation: Restart server. Ensure completeCycle() passes cycle_id to createFeature(). Implement GET /api/features/:id/traceability.

p2_findings.title: Bug Backlog Missing Recommendations for 26 of 34 Entries
p2_findings.recommendation: Add file, recommendation, and work_item_id fields to all P2 entries in bug backlog JSON.

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Requirements Still Missing FR-033-FR-069
p2_findings.recommendation: Update enforcer to read all 3 requirements files or consolidate into one covering all 69 FRs.

p2_findings.title: Bug Backlog Has No work_item_id Cross-References to DB Records
p2_findings.recommendation: Add work_item_id field to each finding referencing the FR-XXXX or BUG-XXXX in the platform's DB.

p3_findings.title: 16 Non-Meta FRs Lack Formal Source // Verifies: Comments
p3_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-XXX markers to the 16 identified source files.

p3_findings.title: Cycles List Endpoint Missing team_name and feedback[]
p3_findings.recommendation: Update listCycles() to hydrate team_name via JOIN on pipeline_runs.

p4_findings.title: Bugs Table Uses Polymorphic Pattern Instead of Direct related_fr_id FK
p4_findings.recommendation: Acceptable design choice if documented. Add CHECK constraint for format validation.

p4_findings.title: Pipeline Runs Team Field Has Hardcoded Default 'TheATeam'
p4_findings.recommendation: Remove DEFAULT, require explicit team declaration on pipeline run creation.
